messages:
maria: Hey everyone — launching the Community Maintainer Starter Kit v0.1 today! :tada:

maria: TL;DR: a lightweight repo template, onboarding checklist, review/playbook snippets, and a maintainer FAQ. We also published a short video walkthrough and set up recurring office hours for new contributors. Release notes + assets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-starter-kit/releases/tag/v0.1

release-bot: Automated release published: community-starter-kit v0.1 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-starter-kit/releases/tag/v0.1

jon: awesome — congrats team. where do folks sign up to be official maintainers?

maria: jon: sign-up form here: https://tinyurl.com/rw-maintainer-signup — we’ll review applications weekly and assign initial triage buddies. deadline for cohort 1 is Mon 2026-04-06.

sara: Does the kit include a CODEOWNERS template and a suggested label taxonomy?

maria: yes — CODEOWNERS, ISSUE_TEMPLATE, PR_TEMPLATE, and a recommended label set (bug/feature/needs-triage/security). We also included a small GH Action to auto-label based on title heuristics.

aj: can we add a simple triage action to flag stale approvals so maintainers know when to ping?

maria: good call — putting that on the roadmap for v0.2. If you want to prototype the action, open a draft PR against the repo and tag me.

heidi: I can run the first office hours intro session on Wed 2026-04-08 15:00 UTC — will demo the checklist and live walk through opening a first-timers issue.

liam: 15:00 UTC works for me. Could we also record it for APAC folks?

heidi: yes — will record and post in #announcements and #community after the session.

jon: love the microgrants mention in the release notes — any guidance on applying?

maria: we included a short microgrant playbook in the repo docs. The sign-up form above has an opt-in checkbox to request a grant — small awards for folks shipping a first contribution or maintainers running outreach events.

aj: :thumbsup: happy to help review initial applications.

maria: thank you all — please star the repo, try the templates on a sandbox repo, and share feedback in the issue tracker (label: kit-feedback). We want this to be low-friction for new contributors.

sara: quick nit — can we add a short blurb about security triage contact points?

maria: noted. adding a SECURITY_CONTACTS section in the next patch.

jon: congrats again y'all — excited to see this land in the wild. :party-parrot:
